candidate.title: TruSeq™ Small RNA
candidate.scope: The single linear TruSeq™ Small RNA library-preparation outline in the assigned Illumina poster panel: small RNA fragment to an adapter-derived, reverse-transcribed, amplified indexed DNA library ready for cluster generation. No version number or alternative workflow is depicted. Interpretation is at schematic scope, not a complete experimental protocol. The biological target is the input small RNA; its sequence is represented by the DNA insert in the final library, while P5/P7 and the index are introduced technical sequence features. The diagram establishes this representation route, not calibrated recovery of every input molecule or cell-of-origin assignment.

operations.label: Ligate adapters

operations.mechanism: Adapter ligation as labeled; the order of individual end-ligation reactions is not resolved by this combined panel.
operations.information_effect: Retains the RNA insert between distinct adapter flanks that provide interfaces for the subsequent primer-dependent steps.

operations.label: Add primer
operations.description: Add a primer to the adapter-ligated RNA; the resulting short second segment is paired with the green 3′ adapter region.

operations.label: Reverse transcription
operations.description: Extend the primer into a complementary DNA strand across the adapter-flanked RNA template, changing the short paired segment into a full-length paired product.
operations.mechanism: Primer-dependent reverse transcription, identified by the source caption and strand extension.
operations.information_effect: Transfers the small RNA sequence into a complementary DNA carrier for amplification.

evidence.locator: Reverse transcription: downward arrow to the paired full-length strands
Add primer to Reverse transcription panels
evidence.rationale: The short primer at the right adapter becomes a full complementary strand under the Reverse transcription caption, supporting template-directed DNA copying.

operations.label: Denature and amplify
operations.description: Process the reverse-transcribed product into the final indexed duplex. The intermediate shows separated template strands engaged by P5-bearing and Index 1/P7-bearing primers; the next downward arrow leads to a full-length product containing the terminal additions. Retain denaturation and amplification as the single combined operation labeled by the drawing.
operations.mechanism: Denaturation and primer-mediated amplification as labeled and drawn; the panel does not enumerate the internal amplification steps.
operations.information_effect: Amplifies the small-RNA-derived DNA insert and adds the depicted P5/P7 terminal interfaces and index sequence. The figure ends at library readiness for cluster generation; it does not show a sequencing measurement.
